metadata.title: Construction Experiment of Multigauge Interference Readout Conserved Quantities in an ABC Closed Phase System
metadata.description: This release publishes a numerical constructive experiment on whether mass-like, momentum-like, and energy-like conserved readouts can be constructed from multigauge interference in an ABC closed phase system without assuming background coordinates. The paper reconstructs p_read, E_read, and R_read from multiple gauges, diagnoses the failure of simple q -> -q reversal under asymmetric R, and constructs an R-weighted generalized collision map conserving R*p and R*p^2. The release includes Japanese and English manuscripts, TeX/PDF builds, executed numerical scripts, result JSON/CSV files, figures, verification notes, and a reproducibility bundle.
metadata.notes: This paper does not claim a derivation of standard momentum, standard energy, or standard mass. The tested result is internal to the Wave Information Readout series: p_read, E_read, R_read, R*p, and R*p^2 can be consistently constructed as conserved readouts from multigauge interference in the tested ABC closed phase system.

title: Construction Experiment of Multigauge Interference Readout Conserved Quantities in an ABC Closed Phase System
